TAA/FSR/cross-frame-history are inert under DETERMINISTIC, so any phase-2 V-layer touching history (V2 aliasing especially) MUST ALSO pass regime (b): the motion-dump boiling band in dx12-noise-floor.json (RegimeB_BoilingBand). The golden SHA gate is structurally blind to the temporal subsystem.
Oracle.StateHalf: GBV (BALLISTIC_DX12_DEBUG=1 BALLISTIC_DX12_GBV=1 BALLISTIC_DX12_BREAK_ON_ERROR=1, run Runtime.exe DIRECTLY -- bal render captures stderr) must stay zero-NEW-error vs dx12-gbv-baseline.json through phase 2. Pixel-neutral is necessary but NOT sufficient for barrier correctness (a wrong-timing barrier can be pixel-clean and GBV-dirty).
